title: Fracture Feature Reel
description: Two identical women in blood-stained golden dresses sit side by side in director's chairs, each holding a white theatrical mask. One wears a mechanical eye device. The scene is viewed through a shattered mirror or glass with purple lightning cracking across the stormy sky. Film reels, a clapperboard, and broken picture frames with surreal doorways line a flooded, reflective floor.
